system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: pmkusumgrid_track_installation and pmkusumgrid_get_grid_status.. my application_id is KUSUMGRID-APP-10000003, my plant_id is KUSUMGRID-PLT-20000001.

function.name: pmkusumgrid_get_grid_status
function.description: Returns grid_status ('not_connected', 'connected', 'active', 'disrupted') for the solar plant connection. Requires session_token. Does NOT restore grid. Fails if plant_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: pmkusumgrid_track_installation
function.description: Tracks installation_status ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'installed', 'verified', 'operational'). Application must be approved. Requires session_token. Does NOT perform installation. Fails if application not approved or application_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
